verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens portal lists a "Data and Image Subscriptions" offering and a "Farm Product Monthly Subscription", which points to a bulk or extract channel for registry data that would avoid scraping. Both are bare link titles with no detail on content, format, delivery, cost or access terms. missing for 10: documentation of the dataset contents and file formats, evidence that the extracts are freely and publicly downloadable rather than paid or account-gated, a delivery mechanism such as a download URL or feed, and any hands-on confirmation that the extracts exist and work.
